The '''Shanghai Institute for Mathematics and Interdisciplinary Sciences (SIMIS)''' <ref>{{Cite web |title=SIMIS・上海数学与交叉学科研究院 |url=https://www.simis.cn/ |access-date=2025-08-27 |language=en-US}}</ref> is a mathematics research institution in [[Shanghai]], [[China]]. It is a new type of research and development institution jointly supported by the Shanghai Municipal Government, [[Yangpu, Shanghai|Yangpu District]], and [[Fudan University]].

It aims to build a world-class research platform for fundamental science and interdisciplinary studies, combining cutting-edge basic research with talent development and collaboration. With a strong emphasis on fundamental and applied [[mathematics]], as well as interdisciplinary applications in areas such as [[theoretical physics]], [[artificial intelligence]] and [[biomedicine]], the Institute is committed to addressing major scientific challenges and real-world problems.<ref>{{Cite web |last=严茂强 |title=Institute to tackle scientific questions |url=https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202401/04/WS65960bdda3105f21a507a7ed.html |access-date=2025-08-27 |website=www.chinadaily.com.cn}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Shanghai Institute for Mathematics and Interdisciplinary Sciences (SIMIS) |url=https://www.nature.com/nature-index/institution-outputs/China/Shanghai%20Institute%20for%20Mathematics%20and%20Interdisciplinary%20Sciences%20%28SIMIS%29/674ec1aca04845559f067622 |access-date=2025-08-27 |website=Nature Index |language=en}}</ref>

== History ==
The Shanghai Institute for Mathematics and Interdisciplinary Sciences (SIMIS) was inaugurated on November 13, 2023,<ref>{{Cite web |title=New institute destined to be a world leader in math |url=https://www.fudan.edu.cn/en/2024/0105/c344a138938/page.htm |access-date=2025-08-27 |website=www.fudan.edu.cn}}</ref> under the leadership of mathematician [[Shing-Tung Yau]]. The institute is dedicated to advancing both pure and applied mathematics, while also fostering cross-disciplinary research with fields such as physics, biomedicine, and economics. 
As of January 2026,the faculty and postdoctoral researchers number over 100, hailing from nearly 20 countries and regions. This diverse community continually injects vitality into the flourishing world of mathematics. 

Its founding president, [[Shing-Tung Yau]], is renowned for his groundbreaking contributions to differential geometry and mathematical physics. He is a recipient of the [[Fields Medal]] and the [[Wolf Prize in Mathematics]].

== Research ==
SIMIS conducts research across a broad spectrum of mathematics, physics, and computer science, spanning both theoretical and applied directions. The institute hosts several active research groups, each engaged in diverse topics. Current areas of focus include:<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-12-23 |title=Academic – SIMIS・上海数学与交叉学科研究院 |url=https://www.simis.cn/academic/ |access-date=2025-08-27 |language=en-US}}</ref>

* [[Differential geometry|Differential Geometry]]
* [[Algebraic geometry|Algebraic Geometry]]
* [[String theory|String Theory]]
* [[Operator algebra|Operator Algebras]]
* Numerical Algebra and [[Computational geometry|Computational Geometry]]
* Interface of [[Data science|Data Science]] and [[Geometry]]
* [[Computational biology|Computational Biology]] and Computational Medicine
